title: milium pedicellare
intro: Milium pedicellare, commonly known as Chinese Barley Grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Milium pedicellare include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been found to exhibit anti-cancer and anti-diabetic activities.
